description: Refine this exact original creature design while preserving its identity, face, crescent-shaped head, hovering forehead crystal, indigo-cyan-pale-violet palette, pixel scale, three-quarter right-facing battle view, and transparent background. Replace the many thin spider-like legs with exactly four clearly readable floating ribbon-arms, two on each side, shaped like broad folded mantis ribbons rather than insect legs. Give the torso a little more visual weight and a confident upright hovering posture. Keep the long patterned rear mantle as one simple tapered form. Maintain the strong psychic focal point and severe intelligent expression. Simplify small ornamental details so the silhouette will animate cleanly. Do not add legs, wings, clothing, handheld objects, spoons, moustache, text, logos, or resemblance to an existing franchise character.
